sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 29 = check 28; Internal Quality Checks row 29 annotation on combining verifiers in one flow)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow)
evidence: All 54 criteria read pairwise (render 1, constraints 2, functional 42, polish 6, visual 3); ids are unique across files. No observable earns scored credit twice and no pair demands incompatible products. Pairs examined most closely: (a) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:348-353 cw_stale_save_refused and :357-362 cw_stale_save_keeps_draft share the stale-save scenario, but the first grades the server record and history ('saved record or its history contains any of B's values', 'exactly one new revision') and the second grades B's three unsaved fields and continued editing; the refusal in the second is stated as 'First confirm the working control', which qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13 names as the correct split ('refusing a stale save and preserving the dirty editor are different outcomes') and :19 requires for a negative claim. (b) :375-380 cw_live_library_update, :384-389 cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state and :393-398 cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft: the library refresh is the scored observable only in the first; in the second it is the control that produces the situation, and the scored observables are draft, fields, scroll, caret and Undo history; the third grades a notice on the open snippet. (c) Last-good restoration appears in :285-290 (after a throw, with input value and canvas), :294-299 (after a time limit) and :303-308 (after Stop): three distinct triggers each named in environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5, none graded twice. (d) :249-254 cw_output_before_failure_kept disclaims the end reason ('scored by other criteria, not here'); :113-119 cw_same_line_carets disclaims Undo; polish cw_controls_feedback_and_labels and cw_narrow_width_usable disclaim Run output; the three visual criteria disclaim each other's subject. (e) Replace: :141-146 single replacement and advance, :150-155 atomic Undo/Redo and case sensitivity, :159-164 self-containing replacement; different observables. (f) Gate overlap: tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:27-33 cw_shared_saved_record repeats the save, clear-storage, reload leg that opens functional :339-344 cw_save_reload_restart; the gate is zero-weight (tests/scoring.toml) and the scored criterion's own outcome is the restart readback, so there is no double credit. Compatibility: Tab indenting in the editor (:69-74) coexists with the polish keyboard exit because that criterion accepts a displayed non-Tab way out; cw_run_starts_fresh_document and cw_last_good_recovery concern successive successful runs versus a failed run; inline HTML handlers (:222-227) and refused eval/Function/Worker/import (:330-335) are satisfiable together. Measured support that one product meets all criteria at once: the scripted golden run on these exact bytes reports true for all 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 gate checks with no page errors (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, persist-before.json, persist-after.json). That is a scripted check, not a configured-judge run; no judge run exists for these bytes. Residual observation, not a defect: failures are correlated by shared preconditions, for example an app with no live library refresh loses :375, :384 and :393 together (5.0 of 58.5 functional weight) and an app that accepts stale saves loses :348 and :357 (3.0); each is a required control rather than a repeated observable.
